detours.why: The Downtown Connector (I-75/85) runs between the Techwood halls and Tech Square; the walk crosses it on the Fifth Street bridge.
OSM maps no path from North Avenue East into the complex's courtyard, so the walk leaves by North Avenue and comes back in off Centennial Olympic Park Drive.
Buildings and parking fill the block on the straight line with no mapped path through, so walks go round by the streets and sidewalks.
